sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a chic vintage touch to your everyday look with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Silver Bracelet Watch, featuring a beautiful aqua blue dial and a sleek silver mesh bracelet. The delicate round dial, elegant metallic finish and unique bow-inspired detailing around the dial give this watch a refined and feminine appearance.
The fine mesh strap creates a lightweight, comfortable look while the soft blue dial adds a subtle pop of colour. Perfect for women who love minimal yet distinctive vintage-inspired accessories that can be styled effortlessly with both western and ethnic outfits.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
- 🤍 Anti-tarnish silver-tone finish
- 💙 Elegant aqua blue dial
- 🔗 Fine stainless-steel-style mesh bracelet
- 🎀 Unique bow-inspired detailing around the dial
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Elegant jewellery-inspired design
- 👗 Easy to style with ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Perfect gifting option for women
- ✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
College, office, casual outings, date nights, parties, festive occasions and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
